svg.text: Cloud-Native Campus Placement Platform | Region: us-east-1 | Automated Multi-AZ VPC Deployment

g.text: • Hall Ticket & Offer LOI Document Renderer
• Compound Unique Index: @@unique([driveId, userId]) rejects simultaneous double-click submissions.
• Foreign Key Cascades: Maintains strict referential integrity across drives, applications, and interview rounds.
• Automated Backups & Snapshots: 1-day retention point-in-time recovery on 20 GB gp3 high-speed SSD.
• Direct Pre-Signed Uploads: Browser → S3 via SigV4 PUT
• Zero EC2 Bottleneck: Binary PDF streams bypass API server
• Server-Side Encryption: AES-256 (SSE-S3) encryption at rest
• Block Public Access: Enabled; private bucket with temporary URLs
• Deployment Bundle: Stores placementhub-app.zip for EC2
• Structural OCR: Parses LINE and WORD blocks accurately
• Academic History: Regex parsing for CGPA, branch, batch
• Cost Optimization: Read once, cached in PostgreSQL
• High Availability: Zero-cost fallback to local unpdf library
• Asynchronous Push: Fans out drive releases to student inboxes
• Decoupled Architecture: Eliminates slow SMTP connections
• Dual-Ledger Audit: AWS MessageId recorded in DB
• Resilience Fallback: Local secondary topic ensures live demo
• High-CPU Alarm: Triggers when CPU > 80% for 2 periods
• Health Dashboard: EC2 CPU Time-Series & StatusChecks
• IAM Instance Profile: Automatic credential rotation (IMDSv2)
• Zero Hardcoded Secrets: Scoped policy on EC2 IAM role
• Systems Manager (SSM): Secure SSH-less terminal shell
Infrastructure as Code: Defined in Terraform (>=1.5) | HashiCorp AWS Provider ~> 5.0/6.0 | Automated Multi-AZ Security Group Policies
